name: Weather
summary: Current conditions and short forecasts from wttr.in / Open-Meteo — no API key.
description: Gets current weather and short-range forecasts via `wttr.in` or Open-Meteo, no API key required. Not for historical data, severe-weather alerts, or detailed meteorological analysis. Queries run through **Curl Request**.
readWhen: user asks about weather, temperature, or forecasts for any location
